rationale: The workflow already implements the primary supported optimization: the build job uses actions/cache@v3 to cache ~/software (ROOT, Geant4, and option dependencies) keyed by runner OS and dependency versions, matching P-LIT-GHA-CACHE. Adding another equivalent cache is contraindicated ("An equivalent cache already exists"). The matrix already uses fail-fast: false, preserving all OS/option outcomes; switching to fail-fast: true (P-LIT-FAIL-FAST) would reduce required coverage and is contraindicated because every matrix outcome is required. P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT is unsafe without representative timing history: ROOT/Geant4 source builds and Gate compilation can run well over an hour, so an arbitrary timeout risks breaking valid slow runs. P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE could add concurrency gating, but required-check status is unverified and canceling in-progress runs may affect required checks. The benchmarks job uses a pre-built Docker image and depends on the cached build job, so no additional supported, safe change is evident.
